scope: Panel grammar observations from visually checked primary-paper figures. Not experimental data or permission to reproduce publisher artwork. One paper per class; none qualifies as a three-paper default.

records.visual_style: Several electrolyte spectra overlaid in distinct colors; narrow wavenumber window about 720-920 cm^-1; vertical dashed guides mark selected bands; legend sits inside the axes. The spectroscopy panel is part of a solvation-structure figure rather than a stand-alone full-range spectrum.
what_not_to_infer: Do not assign a vibrational band or coordination state from a visible trough alone; retain the paper's assignment and sample composition.
Do not convert transmittance to absorbance or normalize traces without the raw spectra and a stated transform.
This one example does not establish a universal FTIR peak window or default color mapping.
records.verification: Figure label, caption, axes, units and neighboring panels were read on the rendered original PDF page.

records.visual_style: Offset, color-coded 7Li NMR traces arranged vertically, each labeled by electrolyte; a shared dashed vertical reference line helps compare peak positions. The chemical-shift axis runs from positive values at left toward negative values at right.
what_not_to_infer: Vertical offsets and trace heights are not quantitative concentration comparisons unless acquisition, processing and normalization are supplied.
Do not turn the peak-shift ordering into a complete solvation mechanism without the Raman/MD evidence and stated referencing.
The y-axis unit is unknown, not assumed to be arbitrary units.
records.verification: Figure label, caption, axes and trace arrangement were read on the rendered original PDF page; DOI was read from PDF metadata/link.

records.y: Left axis: G(r); right axis: Coordination number
paired_with: Fig. 1g: MD snapshots of the same electrolyte classes
records.visual_style: Three aligned small multiples, one electrolyte per panel, share the distance axis. Solid colored curves show pair-specific RDF peaks; dashed curves use a secondary right axis for cumulative coordination number; the MD snapshots below provide the structural context.
what_not_to_infer: Do not derive a coordination number by reading the RDF peak height; integration requires density, species definition and cutoff radius.
Do not mix the left G(r) scale with the right coordination-number scale.
Do not treat MD-derived curves as direct experimental measurement or copy the published trajectories.
records.verification: Three panel letters, dual axes, units, line styles, legends and pairing with MD snapshots were checked visually on the original PDF page.

paired_with: Figure 3b: coordinated numbers and free-EA fraction
records.visual_style: Two side-by-side line charts with matching electrolyte color legend and 0-50 ps time range; panel c is +25 °C and panel d is -70 °C. Colored trajectories rise from near zero, with separate y ranges suited to each temperature.
what_not_to_infer: Do not claim an ion diffusion coefficient from a decorative line or a single end point; a stated linear fit interval, simulation conditions, dimensionality and unit conversion are needed.
Do not compare slopes between the temperature panels without accounting for their different y-axis ranges.
The paper shows simulated Li+ MSD, not an experimentally measured diffusion curve.
records.verification: Figure caption, temperature labels, axes, units, legend and adjacent MD panels were checked on the rendered original PDF page.

paired_with: Fig. 1d-g: RDF, coordination numbers and MD snapshots
records.visual_style: Five electrolyte traces on common 3.0-5.0 V axes, with a compact legend inside the upper-left of the chart. The panel labels the Al substrate and scan rate 0.1 mV s^-1; curves diverge near high voltage.
what_not_to_infer: An oxidation onset or electrochemical window cannot be read as an intrinsic material constant without a stated threshold, electrode/cell configuration, reference and scan rate.
Do not compare this current-density scale with LSV from another study lacking equivalent area and setup.
Do not infer full-cell cycle life from LSV alone.
records.verification: Panel letter, legend, electrode note, scan-rate note, axes and units were checked visually; Figure caption identifies Li||Al cells.

unit.derived_tLi_plus: dimensionless, not itself a plotted axis

records.visual_style: Two adjacent current-decay plots for commercial 301 and TEH-2m-LiTD+10%FEC, each with an inset Nyquist comparison before and after polarization. The current axis and inset impedance axes are kept distinct.
what_not_to_infer: Do not read tLi+ directly from the final current level; calculation also needs the polarization voltage and initial/steady currents and resistances under the stated method.
Do not invent numerical transference values when only the plotted transients and insets are available.
Do not replace the impedance insets with unrelated EIS traces or present them as a second current axis.
records.verification: Figure caption, two chronoamperometry subplots, inset impedance axes and units were checked on the rendered original PDF page.
